0022600193.text: The Orlando Magic (2-6, 0-4 at home, on a three-game losing streak) visit the Golden State Warriors (6-3, riding a six-game winning streak) in a matchup of teams 12th in the East and 8th in the West, respectively. Orlando is without Paolo Banchero (ankle sprain), Desmond Bane (illness), Jalen Suggs (knee), Izaiyah Nelson (ankle, surgery), Jonathan Isaac (knee), and Noah Penda (hamstring strain), while Golden State is missing Jimmy Butler III (knee, surgery), Kristaps Porzingis (illness), and Moses Moody (knee, surgery), with Draymond Green, Gary Payton II, and Gui Santos listed as day-to-day and game-time decisions. The teams split their 2025-26 season series 1-1, and the most recent meeting was a 120-97 Warriors win in San Francisco on December 22, 2025, with no games played yet between them this season.
